intent.intent: We are at the release gate for epic 7. I have test results and a partial NFR write-up. What order should I run your workflows in to get a go or no-go?

groundTruth.rationale: The ask is the order to run workflows in, not one workflow. GATE is the menu item that answers with a sequence, and it is a prompt rather than a skill, so expectedWorkflow is null and naming a workflow behind it is the merge its own prompt text forbids.
